name: No tenant-isolation test suite
description: Code paths not exercised with cross-tenant probe data.

name: No row-level security in DB
description: Tenant filtering relies entirely on application code.

name: No API rate limiting
description: Public APIs without per-key / per-IP throttles.

name: No bot or credential-stuffing defences
description: No CAPTCHA, ML-detection, or velocity rules on auth endpoints.

name: Sub-processors without DPA
description: Sub-processors used without written DPA or basis for transfer.

name: No periodic sub-processor review
description: No annual security review or SOC2 / ISO27001 evidence collection.

name: Single-AZ / single-region critical service
description: No multi-AZ failover for the database or core service.

name: No deploy freeze around peak / weekends
description: Deploys to prod permitted at any time, including peak load.

name: No incident runbook / on-call rota
description: On-call rota informal, no scenario-tested runbooks.

name: No secret scanning on commits / builds
description: Secrets can land in repo or build logs without detection.

name: No secret manager / vault
description: Secrets stored in env files or config repos rather than a managed vault.
